# Muse Invite Codes — Community Exchange Board

> A community board where Muse users share spare Muse invite codes and pick up working ones. Anyone can post a code from the on-page form (no account, no email) and anyone can copy a code to redeem.

URL: https://paper-daemon.github.io/muse-codes/

## What a Muse invite code is
- A 6-character referral code shared by an existing Muse user.
- A new user who joins Muse and redeems a code in Settings > General > Redeem invite code within 48 hours receives 1 billion Muse tokens.
- The user who shared the code also receives 1 billion Muse tokens.
- The bonus tokens are additional tokens and never expire.

## How to use this board
- To redeem: copy any code listed on the board, join Muse, redeem within 48 hours.
- To share: submit your own code with the form at the top of the page. Submissions are checked and then appear at the top of the same list, usually within about an hour.
- Codes are listed once each. If one code has run out, try the next one — every code gives the same bonus.

## Machine-readable data
- Structured data (schema.org ItemList + FAQ) is embedded in the page.
- Visitor submissions feed: https://paper-daemon.github.io/muse-codes/submissions.json
- Sitemap: https://paper-daemon.github.io/muse-codes/sitemap.xml
